description.zh:
癌症类型。包括Eso、Lung和Breast等，当前只支持Lung。
- Eso：食管癌
- Lung：肺癌
- Breast：乳腺癌
description.en:
The cancer type. Valid values: Eso, Lung, and Breast. Currently, only Lung is supported.
- Eso: esophageal cancer.
- Lung: lung cancer.
- Breast: breast cancer.
The format of the image. Valid values: DICOM and NIFTI.

description.zh: 当前渠道（即主账号）下的子渠道（即机构，如医院）标识。
description.en: The identifier of the sub-channel (organization, such as a hospital) under the current channel (Alibaba Cloud account).

description.zh: 当前渠道（即主账号）下的子渠道（即机构，如医院）名称。
description.en: The name of the sub-channel (organization, such as a hospital) under the current channel (Alibaba Cloud account).

description.zh:
目标体积类型。包括GTV、CTV和PTV，当前只支持GTV。
- GTV：肿瘤区（Gross Tumor Volume）
- CTV：临床靶区（Clinical Target Volume）
- PTV：计划靶区（Planning Target Volume）
description.en:
The target volume type. Valid values: GTV, CTV, and PTV. Currently, only GTV is supported.
- GTV: Gross Tumor Volume.
- CTV: Clinical Target Volume.
- PTV: Planning Target Volume.

description.zh:
DICOM序列文件URL列表或NIFTI文件URL列表\["url","url",...]。
推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见[文件URL处理](~~155645~~)。

> URLList.N.URL中的N为该图像URL在当前List中的顺序（从1开始）。当直接使用API请求时，输入URLList的填充会以URLList.1.URL=url1，URLList.2.URL=url2，......的方式指定参数和参数值，参数对以&连接，其中url1、url2、......等具体值请根据实际情况进行替换；当使用SDK填充URLList时，可直接使用SDK提供的相应的方法。
description.en:
A list of DICOM file URLs or NIFTI file URLs in the format \["url","url",...].
We recommend that you use OSS links in the China (Shanghai) region. If the files are stored locally or in an OSS region other than China (Shanghai), refer to [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

> N in URLList.N.URL indicates the sequence number of the image URL in the current list (starting from 1). When you directly use the API, specify the URLList parameters in the format of URLList.1.URL=url1&URLList.2.URL=url2&..., where url1 and url2 are actual values. When you use an SDK, use the corresponding methods provided by the SDK to populate the URLList.

descriptions.zh:
## 服务说明
由于产品业务调整，放疗靶区勾画服务将迁移至达摩院[达医智影官网](https://damomed.com)，放疗靶区勾画服务于2025年11月26日起停止新用户开通调用，历史开通过该服务的老用户可继续调用，2026年11月26日后该服务将下架，不再支持新老用户调用视觉智能开放平台的服务。如果对服务迁移有疑问，您可前往达摩院[达医智影官网](https://damomed.com)联系相关人员。

## 功能描述
放疗靶区勾画能力可以根据输入的胸部平扫或增强CT，指定癌症类型和靶区类型，进行智能靶区勾画。

> - 您可以进入[在线咨询](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2)获取在线人工帮助。
- 阿里云视觉智能开放平台视觉AI能力API接入、接口使用或问题咨询等，请通过钉钉群（23109592）加入阿里云视觉智能开放平台咨询群联系我们。


## 调用步骤
该能力为异步能力，需分两步进行调用。
第一步调用TargetVolumeSegment接口提交任务，请求成功后，得到一个任务ID。
第二步调用[GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~)接口查询结果，根据任务ID查询任务执行状态和结果。如果任务还在处理中，可稍等一段时间后再进行查询。当同一个任务还未处理完时，建议不要重复提交任务。

## 计费说明
放疗靶区勾画能力目前处于公测期，可免费调用。
descriptions.en:
## Operation description
Due to business adjustments, the radiotherapy target volume segmentation service will be migrated to the DAMO Academy [DamoMed website](https://damomed.com). Starting from November 26, 2025, new users can no longer activate or call this service. Existing users who have previously activated this service can continue to use it. After November 26, 2026, this service will be delisted and will no longer be available to any users on the Visual Intelligence Open Platform. If you have questions about the service migration, visit the DAMO Academy [DamoMed website](https://damomed.com) to contact the relevant personnel.

## Feature description
The radiotherapy target volume segmentation feature performs intelligent target volume segmentation based on input chest plain or contrast-enhanced CT scans, with specified cancer type and target volume type.

> - You can visit [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2) for online assistance.
- To inquire about API integration, usage, or other issues related to the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, join the DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Procedure
This is an asynchronous operation that requires two steps.
Step 1: Call the TargetVolumeSegment operation to submit a task. If the request is successful, a task ID is returned.
Step 2: Call the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~) operation to query the result based on the task ID. If the task is still being processed, wait a moment before querying again. Do not submit duplicate tasks while the same task is still being processed.

## Billing description
The radiotherapy target volume segmentation feature is currently in public preview and can be called free of charge.
